meta.title: Vendor sees their current zone and can bid to move zones
gaps: Reliably assert the traffic-light zone's visual colour treatment or prove the vendor can move zones using only trial and error beyond the observed textual zone changes.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Reliably assert the traffic-light zone's visual colour treatment or prove the vendor can move zones using only trial and error beyond the observed textual zone changes.

steps.note: Open the single-stage creation flow required for configuring a traffic-light auction.
Configure a buy auction with a green-to-yellow traffic-light range.
Give the event the required title.
Apply the first available pricing template before adding line items.
Add one product for the vendor to bid on.
Invite one QA vendor who will submit and revise the bid.
Confirm the event reached a published project page.
Continue in the invited vendor's supplier portal.
Open the auction bid sheet as the vendor.
Submit an initial bid above the configured upper bound so the vendor enters the red zone.
Confirm the initial vendor bid was submitted.
Check that the vendor's current displayed zone is red after the initial bid.
Revise the same vendor's bid into the configured lower band to move to a safer zone.
Confirm the revised bid was submitted.
Check that the displayed zone updates to green after the revised bid crosses the band.
